description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%), representing accuracy percentage, across six different models: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from approximately 3 to 3000, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, spanning from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The Base model is represented by a black line with circle markers and a solid style, increasing from around 61 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 to approximately 69 at 3000. The FT model is depicted by a blue line with inverted triangle markers and a solid style, rising from about 62 at 3 to roughly 70 at 3000. The IKE model is shown as a red line with triangle markers and a solid style, growing from around 64 at 3 to approximately 72 at 3000. The MEND model is illustrated by a brown line with diamond markers and a solid style, starting at about 68 at 3 and reaching around 78 at 3000. The MEMIT model is represented by a purple line with star markers and a solid style, beginning at approximately 67 at 3 and increasing to roughly 75 at 3000. The ROME model is displayed as a green line with square markers and a solid style, starting at around 74 at 3 and rising to approximately 84 at 3000. All lines exhibit an upward trend as the Co-occurrence Number increases.
